items.title: Detect secrets before they ship with the GitGuardian power for Amazon Kiro
items.summary: AI coding agents can write and commit code faster than pipeline scanners can check it, and hardcoded secrets are one of the first risks to surface. In this post, we show how the GitGuardian Kiro power detects secrets at the moment code is written, and how AWS Secrets Manager completes the remediation loop by storing, encrypting, and rotating replacement credentials, so exposed secrets become a code change, not an incident.
items.creator: Akram Al Sheikh
